runtime_evidence_gaps: No runtime evidence fresher than 2h is available; profitability, canary or live-readiness claims cannot be made for any strategy.
strategy_lab_windows table data is absent from evidence; profit_factor, win/loss counts and net P&L metrics cannot be confirmed.
Execution failure rates and signal-skip counts for shadow windows are unobserved.
architecture_summary: The Strategy Laboratory (learnerbot/strategy_lab.py) provides a well-gated SHADOW-first pipeline with MIN_PROFIT_FACTOR=1.10, mandatory simulation/preflight, and atomic promotion controls. Cross-chain signals are handled separately in cross_chain_strategy_signals.py with independent SOLANA/EVM models. The shadow executor (shadow_strategy_executor.py) correctly writes results without touching live capital. The contract validator (three_agent_strategy_contract.py) enforces review_only/no_live_changes flags and requires falsifiable shadow_test on every proposal. No live-execution bypass, credential, or signing material was observed in the strategy lab path.

proposals.name: New-pool liquidity-confirmed momentum entry — Solana
proposals.rationale: Pools created within the last 30 minutes on Jupiter with >=3 SOL single-sided depth and a 5-minute price change of +8–35% (avoiding extreme pump/dump outliers) show a mean reversion window of 2–6 minutes that can be exploited with a tight 4% stop-loss and 6% take-profit target. The hypothesis is falsifiable: if median net P&L across >=10 shadow trades falls below 0 after Jupiter swap fees (~0.25%) and estimated slippage (0.5%), the strategy is disqualified.

evidence.note: MIN_PROFIT_FACTOR, MIN_EVALUATION_TRADES, MIN_ELIGIBLE_OPPORTUNITIES thresholds govern promotion eligibility.
Existing cross-chain signal framework; Solana new-pool signal can be added here.
Research module for DEX Screener and Jupiter data ingestion.

proposals.shadow_test: Run >= 10 shadow trades on Solana pools aged < 30 min with 5-min price change 8–35%. Net P&L after Jupiter fees and estimated slippage must be > 0 across the evaluation window. Profit factor must exceed 1.10. If either threshold is missed the strategy is disqualified without promotion.
proposals.runtime_evidence_needed: Shadow window P&L from strategy_lab_windows for this strategy ID.

proposals.name: New-pool liquidity-confirmed momentum entry — EVM
proposals.rationale: Same economic hypothesis as PROP-001 applied to EVM (Polygon/Arbitrum). Uniswap V3/V2 pools created within 30 min with >=1000 USD single-sided depth and 5-min price change 8–35%. EVM gas and MEV exposure are higher than Solana, so cost model must be calibrated separately before any shadow-to-active promotion is considered.

evidence.note: Strategy Lab governance thresholds apply identically on EVM.
EVM signal branch can be added alongside Solana signal.
EVM gas/fee model for cost-adjusted P&L simulation.

proposals.shadow_test: Run >= 10 shadow trades on EVM pools aged < 30 min with 5-min price change 8–35%. Net P&L after gas, swap fee and estimated MEV slippage must be > 0 across the evaluation window. Profit factor must exceed 1.10. EVM shadow results must be collected independently and not merged with Solana results.
proposals.runtime_evidence_needed: Shadow window P&L from strategy_lab_windows for this strategy ID on EVM chain.

proposals.name: Shadow strategy participation rate audit
proposals.rationale: The strategy lab enforces MIN_ELIGIBLE_PARTICIPATION=0.20 (20% of eligible opportunities must be taken). Without runtime evidence it is unknown whether any live/shadow strategy is suppressing valid trades through overly restrictive filters (e.g. sellability gate, positive-edge gate). A participation rate audit across all strategy IDs in strategy_lab_windows would identify strategies that repeatedly see eligible opportunities but rarely act, which is a leading indicator of miscalibrated filters rather than genuine edge absence.

evidence.note: MIN_ELIGIBLE_PARTICIPATION=0.20 threshold defined; participation rate is computed from eligible_opportunities vs trades in strategy_lab_windows.
Shadow executor records signal_skips per window; high skip counts with low trade counts indicate filter suppression.

proposals.shadow_test: Query strategy_lab_windows for all SHADOW and ACTIVE strategies. Flag any strategy where trades/eligible_opportunities < 0.10 over >= 3 windows with eligible_opportunities >= 10. For flagged strategies, inspect signal_skips breakdown to identify which gate is suppressing trades.
proposals.runtime_evidence_needed: strategy_lab_windows rows for all active shadow strategies with eligible_opportunities, trades and signal_skips.

cost_and_risk_notes: All proposals target SHADOW status only. No proposal requests live capital, relaxed safety gates, weakened positive-edge checks, or removal of simulation/preflight. Cost models for each proposal are estimates only and must be verified through shadow execution before any promotion review.
deduplication: PROP-001 and PROP-002 share the same economic family but require independent shadow evidence per chain. They are not duplicates. PROP-003 is orthogonal (a governance/audit proposal, not a trading strategy).
